name: Megan M. Sherr

about: Attorney Megan M. Sherr is a founding partner of Sherr Puttmann Akins Lamb PC located in Denver, Colorado. She serves as the firm's President and CEO. Nationally recognized as among the pre-eminent lawyers in her region as well as the entire country, Ms. Sherr provides unmatched counsel and support to clients who are going through a divorce or have some other serious legal issue affecting their families.

A former Deputy District Attorney, Ms. Sherr has extensive trial experience. However, she is also well-versed in mediation and negotiations, and she strives to help her clients resolve their conflicts and reach favorable resolutions in the most efficient and cost-effective manner possible. Honored for her outstanding professionalism and service, she has earned consistent recognition from The Best Lawyers in America, and she has received an AV Preeminent peer review rating from Martindale-Hubbell.

Moreover, Ms. Sherr has received designation as among the Top Family Law Lawyers in 5280 Magazine for years 2016-2026, was voted Barrister's Best - Barristers Choice, Best Family Law Lawyer, Law Week 2024, and Chambers and Partners, Band 1 - High Net Worth Family/Matrimonial. She has also received many other top rankings, honors, awards, and endorsements from her peers along with countless highly favorable testimonials and referrals from her satisfied clients.

A 1996 honors graduate of the University of Colorado, Ms. Sherr obtained her Juris Doctor from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law in 1999. She has published articles and contributed to reference texts regarding family law. Ms. Sherr has given many lectures/presentations and continuing legal education seminars across her region on a variety family law related legal topics.

Ms. Sherr is a member of the Colorado Bar Association, Family Law Section, as well as the Denver, Arapahoe and Douglas-Elbert County Bar Associations. She is also a member of the Colorado Judicial Institute, the Metro Denver Interdisciplinary Committee and the Colorado Women’s Bar Association, among her other professional affiliations.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
